title: fix(metadata-protocol): the save door stores an action as its ActionSchema parse, so requiresFeature / requiresMembershipReach are lowered into visible
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X7aTDKRB5qtXEtLGphyrQr2)_

Fixes #26723

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么:** 元数据保存入口(`/meta` 保存对象、单独保存动作,草稿与发布两种模式)现在把动作按 `ActionSchema` 解析后的结果存盘,`requiresFeature` / `requiresMembershipReach` 会被并入 `visible`。
- **为什么改:** 以前这两个门槛原样存着、没有 `visible`,控制台只读 `visible`,所以普通成员也能看到只给管理员或特定功能开放的按钮。
- **风险与回滚:** 只影响新保存的动作;已存的旧行不改写,重新保存一次即修好。回滚就是 revert 本 PR。
- **先看:** `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-stored-action-parse.ts`(新 helper);`protocol.ts` 保存入口里新增的那一行。
- **两分钟验证:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run src/protocol.stored-action-gate-lowering.test.ts`,应见 7 passed。
- **需要你做的:** 无,席位落地。

## What changes

`saveMetaItem` (`packages/metadata-protocol`) judges an `object` or `action` body by its spec schema. It then stored the request body as written, apart from the operator and form-section grafts. `ActionSchema`'s parse is what lowers `requiresMembershipReach` and `requiresFeature` into `visible`, so a stored action kept both gate keys raw and had no `visible`. The console reads `visible` alone, so the button was offered to every user. This was measured on `origin/main` `4c29f38447` by the red leg below.

The door now stores the parse it already ran. `withParsedStoredActions` (new, `protocol-stored-action-parse.ts`) is called once, right after the existing grafts:

- **`object`:** the object's own `actions` array becomes the parsed array (`ObjectSchema`'s `actions` is `ActionSchema[]`). Every other key of the body stays as written.
- **`action`:** the body is the parsed action.
- **Any other type**, or an object with no `actions` array, is unchanged.

This is the same parse the code-package registration door has stored since #25981 (`parsePackageAction` in `@objectstack/objectql`). The lowering is not re-implemented here: the values are read off the parse tree the door already computed. The parse is idempotent over its own output, so a GET then PUT round trip stores the same bytes (pinned).

The schema block runs before the draft/active split, so both modes are covered by one hunk.

### The action endpoint (measured, ruled)

Asked by the triage line: does `POST /api/v1/actions/:object/:action` enforce the gate? **No.**

- The door checks `requiredPermissions` (`actionPermissionError`, `packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts:832`), the activation switch and the action type.
- `visible` is deliberately unread there (contract point 6, `action-execution.ts:2484`). It is pinned by `action-declarative-update.test.ts` "point 6", run locally: 2 passed.
- The parsed action no longer carries the raw keys: both lowerings return the input without the key. So dispatch cannot see what was declared without a spec change.
- The spec already rules both keys UI courtesy, not authorization (`ui/action.zod.ts` docblocks on `visible` and `requiresMembershipReach`).
- Every in-repo carrier is a `type: 'api'` platform-objects identity action calling a better-auth endpoint, whose own door is the authority. `POST /actions` answers 400 for `api` and `url` actions.

The seat ruled option A on the card: no dispatch enforcement and no spec change. This PR fixes the save door only.

## Tests

New: `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.stored-action-gate-lowering.test.ts`, through the real `saveMetaItem`, reading the `sys_metadata` row the save wrote:

- An object saved in draft and in publish mode, with one action carrying `requiresFeature: 'ssoEnforced'` and one carrying `requiresMembershipReach: 'delete_organization'`, is stored with neither key. Each action has its lowered `visible`, deep-equal to what `ObjectSchema.create` gives the same declaration.
- **Control:** an action without the keys is stored as its parse with no `visible`, and the object's other keys are stored as written.
- Re-saving a stored body stores the same actions (idempotent).
- An object with no `actions` key is stored without one.
- A standalone `action` saved in draft and in publish mode is stored lowered, deep-equal to `ActionSchema.parse`.

<details><summary>Red first, ablation</summary>

- **Red.** With `protocol.ts` written back to the base blob `4ccf8acedb` (no `withParsedStoredActions` reference): `Tests 5 failed | 2 passed (7)`. The two greens are the idempotency and no-`actions` controls. Restored: blob `92f1deab22` equals HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- **Ablation** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --delete`, anchor `request.item = withParsedStoredActions(singularType, request.item, parsed.data);`, hit once): blob `92f1deab22` to `2ecf252721`, anchor 1 to 0. Result: `Tests 5 failed | 2 passed (7)`. The tool restored it: `blob == HEAD (92f1deab22f0) and git diff HEAD is empty`. The test imports `./protocol.js` from source, so there is no dist leg.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Stored rows are not migrated** (ruling). The showcase, the other examples and HotCRM declare neither key on any action (0 carriers in source), so none of their rows carry it from code. A row an author saved through Studio before this fix keeps the raw keys until it is saved again; saving it again stores it lowered.
- **What else the parse adds** to a stored action: schema defaults, and a CEL string shorthand wrapped in `{ dialect, source }`. That is the shape a packaged action is already served in.
- **The UI needs no change.** Nothing under `ui/**` reads `requiresFeature` or `requiresMembershipReach` at runtime. `ui/packages/core/src/actions/ActionRunner.ts:469` is a type declaration only, and the renderers read `visible`.
- **Studio round trip.** After a save, the action shows the composed `visible` and no gate key, as a packaged action already does.
- **Overlap.** #26856 is the only open PR touching `protocol.ts`, and its hunks are far from this one: they sit at lines 216 to 11001, and this hunk is at about line 20950.
